scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/core.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p packages/ui --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/ui.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p packages/extension --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/extension.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/test.tsbuildinfo
scripts.test:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:webview
scripts.test:all: npm run test:fast && npm run test:bundle && npm run test:editor && npm run test:vscode && npm run test:web && playwright test -c packages/extension/e2e/playwright.config.ts
